data.name: Home.Description
data.value: Manage multiple Citus databases with capability-first checks and durable checkpoints.

data.name: Home.ClusterDescription
data.value: Each profile represents one Citus-enabled PostgreSQL database.

data.name: Home.EmptyDescription
data.value: Register a coordinator. A read-only capability scan runs before the profile is saved.

data.name: Cluster.PlanHelp
data.value: After confirmation, the plan queues immediately; the runner rechecks capability and state.

data.name: Cluster.OperationsHelp
data.value: Refreshes every five seconds when HTMX is available.

data.name: Cluster.DeleteHelp
data.value: Deleting a profile removes only control-plane metadata. It does not call citus_remove_node.

data.name: Create.Description
data.value: Test the Citus endpoint, then register the profile. This does not create infrastructure or change the cluster.

data.name: Create.EndpointHelp
data.value: Use a metadata read-only account when only monitoring is required. Credentials are encrypted before storage.

data.name: Create.DatabaseHelp
data.value: Citus metadata is scoped to each database.

data.name: Create.PasswordHelp
data.value: Never logged or returned by the API.

data.name: Create.ScanHelp
data.value: PostgreSQL/Citus version, current database/user, function signatures, metadata views, nodes, distributed tables, and shards.

data.name: Controller.RegisterDetail
data.value: Check host, database, TLS, account, metadata permissions, and the Citus extension.

data.name: Controller.ConnectDetail
data.value: Check host, port, database, TLS, account, metadata permissions, and the Citus extension.

data.name: Controller.InventoryError
data.value: Could not collect inventory. Check network, TLS, authentication, and coordinator state.

data.name: Controller.Deleted
data.value: Local profile deleted. The Citus cluster was not changed.

data.name: Cluster.RemoveConfirmation
data.value: Remove must exactly match the worker host.

data.name: Cluster.CapacityAck
data.value: I confirm backup/PITR was tested, disk/WAL/network/connections are sufficient, and a rollback owner is assigned.

data.name: Cluster.WarningHelp
data.value: Rebalance and drain move data; they are not backups. Remove is available only when the target has exactly zero placements.
